name: Moretsu ☆ Nyan x 2 Clinic ~Joi to Nurse ga Manmosu Giza Ero E→~
original_name: モーレツ☆にゃん×2 クリニック ～女医とナースがマンモスギザエロE→～
source: The main protagonist, heartbroken and hasn't been able to get his penis erect for two months. Feeling desperate he called his friend for advice, his friend strongly suggested for him to go visit a urologist. He felt reluctant at first due to embarrassment but soon agreed thinking that the doctors will be an old guy and granny nurse. To his surprise a voluptuous nurse, a beautiful and gorgeous female urologist and an "onee-san" type pharmacist are there at the clinic, furthermore they're all young and well endowed. Like this his everyday life suddenly gets erotic...
translation: 主角失恋后陷入低潮，已经两个月无法勃起。他绝望地打电话向朋友求助，朋友强烈建议他去看泌尿科医生。起初他因为害羞而有些抗拒，但想到医生应该是老头、护士应该是老太太，便很快答应了。没想到诊所里竟有身材丰满的护士、美丽动人的女泌尿科医生，以及一位姐姐型药剂师，而且她们全都年轻又身材姣好。就这样，他的日常生活突然变得色情起来……
